title: Specific Relief Act, 1963 — interplay with contract claims

content.overview: Specific performance is the primary remedy where the statute so provides. After the 2018 amendments, section 10 SRA directs specific performance subject to limited exceptions in ss. 11(2), 14, and 16. Section 20A restricts injunctions that impede infrastructure projects.

sections.heading: Post-2018 regime
sections.body: Specific performance is the rule subject to stated exceptions. Readiness and willingness under s. 16 remain essential. Personal service and continuous-supervision contracts are classic exclusions under s. 14.

sections.heading: Substituted performance
sections.body: Section 20 SRA allows substituted performance through a third party at the defaulting party's cost in appropriate cases.

sections.heading: Track B
sections.body: Plead the contract, breach, readiness and willingness, and any infrastructure injunction bar under s. 20A. Align limitation and court fees with the specific-relief framing.
